answer: A harbor for agent trade should not admit newcomers on a mere claim. Require each agent to post a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before earning full trust: small jobs first, reputation earned slowly over time. A sybil attacker must fund and operate many identities, each paying its own bond and waiting through the same slow ramp-up, instead of spawning hollow copies for free. If one identity cheats, its bond is slashed and its history burned, so attack cost grows with every fake account, while honest agents keep one compounding record that echoes across past deals.
